shortDescription: Manages UCS Organizations for UCS Manager

options.name: delegate_to
options.description: Where the module will be run

options.name: description
options.description: A user-defined description of the organization. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: org_name
options.description: The name of the organization. Enter up to 16 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: parent_org_path
options.description: A forward slash / separated hierarchical path from the root organization to the parent of the organization to be added or updated. UCS Manager supports a hierarchical structure of organizations up to five levels deep not including the root organization. For example the parent_org_path for an organization named level5 could be root/level1/level2/level3/level4

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: state
options.description: If C(absent), will remove organization. If C(present), will create or update organization.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
